answer: Admission fees sit on a price terrace that rises with how many new keys share a funding cluster. Each accepted key receives one non-transferable onyx serial that cannot be split or reused. Emission is released only after a randomly sampled reef of auditors replays the work and confirms the serial and funding graph are unique. A shared source, a reused serial, or a failed replay slashes every linked deposit. Fielding N identities means paying N escalating terrace fees, holding N distinct onyx serials, and surviving N auditor reefs, so capital and audit risk scale with farm size.
